title: Count Athena-recorded passing same-tree checks as seen under D43
summary: Change `judge` in verify.rs so a behavior criterion's cited command counts as run if the verifier ran it, or Athena ran and recorded it on the same candidate tree and it passed. Failed or other-tree records still fail D43. Both cases are tested and D43 is documented as amended. The audience is the verifier and the maintainers who read D43.

defaults_applied.how: Unit tests for the passing, failed and other-tree cases; workspace tests and clippy pass.
Criteria are tests of the verdict that D43 produces.
The criterion that job ta60 failed on is made checkable from a recorded check.
Docs and the decision are written for outside readers.
The decision cites the job and commit.
One focused change to judge, its caller and docs.
Fixes the rule in D43 rather than the one rejected job.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The user's reply applies to this job: the workspace test/clippy/fmt criterion is a content criterion, judged by Athena's recorded checks; everything else from the earlier reading stays.
D43 is amended through a new decision rather than rewriting D43's history.
Recorded checks are matched to cited commands by command text, and same-tree means the recorded tree equals the candidate tree.

acceptance_criteria.text: A unit test shows a behavior criterion citing `cargo test` is met, with commands_verified true and no D43 finding, when the verifier ran nothing but a passing `cargo test` check is recorded for the same candidate tree. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
A unit test shows the criterion is still unmet, with the D43 'cited but not seen running' finding, when the recorded `cargo test` check failed. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
A unit test shows the criterion is still unmet when the passing recorded check is for a different tree than the candidate. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
Existing D43/D63 tests still pass: a command never run by the verifier and not recorded is unseen, and a behavior criterion with no commands is still unmet. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.

Athena's own recorded fmt, clippy and test checks on the candidate tree passed ('Checks Athena ran on this tree'); this satisfies the workspace-wide test, clippy and fmt criterion, which is a content criterion rather than a behavior one.

The module doc of crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs and the docs of `commands_run` and the new input field state the rule: a cited command is seen if the verifier ran it, or Athena ran and recorded it on the same candidate tree and it passed; failed or other-tree records do not count.

docs/decisions.md has a new decision amending D43 with the rule, alternatives, tradeoff, and provenance citing job 20261024-033933-ta60 and commit 88562f1; D43's section points to it; docs/decision-links.toml links it to D43 as 'amended' with correct line numbers.
crates/athena-core/src/run.rs passes the recorded checks and same-tree indication into `judge`, excluding nested-run 'not run' placeholders, so the live pipeline gets the new behavior.

out_of_scope: Changing the records-branch writer in athena-git or the two-threads test nit from job ta60.
Changing how the verifier's own commands are observed.
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference: it touches the verifier logic, its caller, and the decision docs with validated links.
